priority.description: Colour emphasis of the value graphics (the Figma "Type" axis); off blanks them on a flat disc

barStyle.description: Bar rendering (the Figma "Style" axis): tint (default) shows a tint bar with strong cap pills, fill a strong bar without pills

scalePosition.description: Rotates the whole layout — ports, scale, setpoint and readout side (the designs' two-way Direction / three-way Scale axis)

value.description: Through-flow of the right outlet port, 0-100 (%)

bottomValue.description: Bottom outlet flow, 0-100 (%). Available when type==three-way.

large.description: Show scale, labels, readout and setpoint layer

label.description: Readout label text. Available when large==true.

unit.description: Readout unit text. Available when large==true.

tag.description: Identifier line under the compact readout stack, e.g. '#0001'. Available when large==false && hasLabelStack==true.

faceDiameter.description: Ring diameter in CSS pixels. When set, the face renders at a fixed intrinsic size (equal circumference across instruments sharing the value); when unset (default), the face contain-fits its container.

setpoint.description: Target setpoint value. undefined = no setpoint marker shown.

newSetpoint.description: Adjustment preview for 2-step interface. When defined, two markers are shown: original (dimmed) + new (focus). Available when setpoint!=undefined.

touching.description: User is physically interacting with the control. Suppresses at-setpoint calculation and triggers focus visual. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

autoAtSetpointDeadband.description: Tolerance for auto at-setpoint detection. Available when setpoint!=undefined && autoAtSetpoint==true.

setpointAtZeroDeadband.description: Tolerance for zero-snap visual state. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

setpointOverride.description: Override to derive the setpoint color from the instrument's priority regardless of instrument state. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

animateSetpoint.description: Enable CSS-animated confirm transition. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
